preamble: The Middle Chinese retroflex stops of the 知 (zhī) group (*ɖ) became retroflex affricates in Mandarin; the voiced [ɖ] devoiced to unaspirated [ʈʂ] in the oblique tones (aspirated [ʈʂʰ] in the level tone, see d_retroflex_to_ch_retroflex_aspirated).
sources: Pulleyblank, E. G. (1984). Middle Chinese: A Study in Historical Phonology. University of British Columbia Press.
Norman, J. (1988). Chinese. Cambridge University Press.
